balls.text: 133.9kmh, lands right in front of off, Badoni shuffles across to off for the sweep and that has missed the bat and somehow the off stump too! Really good reply from Shepherd to end the innings with two dot balls
attempted wide yorker outside off and he reviews it after missing it. Not a wide because it's inside the line
is this Pooran batting in front of a mirror? Goes leg side this time for the wide gap and he almost sweeps that one away to the deep midwicket boundary. One-bounce four and Badoni isn't happy
similar delivery with width and this time he goes to the left of long-off where the fielders leaps towards the ball and misses by a whisker!
goes wide outside off, it's too full and Badoni walks into that to execute the perfect lofted cover drive for a clean six! Superbly done
wide down the leg side, attempting a yorker and they run across one as well
he goes across to off and swings to leg for one to wide long-on
on middle and leg and flicks it stylishly to long-on, almost trying a helicopter
on the pads, flicked away towards long leg and they come back for the second! Kishan collects the slightly wayward throw and tries to back-flick to the stumps but misses
low and wide full toss is toe-ended away to deep third for one
goes short for a change on leg and Krunal has pulled that away behind square in the vacant area for four
really slow and wide well outside off, Krunal has shuffled across so not a wide after he misses it
137.3kmh, nearly a yorker and it's drilled down to mid-on after a bounce. Hardik puts in an excellent dive to his right, has a shot at the stumps and the batters were short at both ends
a short legbreak outside off and Badoni works it down to long-on. Krunal wanted two to get the strike but there was no time
a lot quicker and flatter outside off, he steers it square for one
comes down the tracks, Chawla cramps him for room around off, and he can't put it away because it hits the pad
flatter on middle and leg, and he blocks this in the 18th over
Krunal finally shows how it's done and lands a six just in front of the sight screen! Bit too full and he smashes it straight down the ground

make that three in three! The two set batters are gone, LSG have suddenly slipped and the crowd is loving it. Rahul went for the sweep against the turn from in front of the stumps and got a leasing edge that Thushara got under easily at short fine

two in two! Both for Pooran and Wadhera. Arshad Khan swings wildly down the ground for the slower ball and miscues it so badly it did't go beyond mid-off where Wadhera took it on second attempt and eventually gave Thushara a wry smile

Thushara has got the big wicket and that will ease some MI nerves! Pooran went a long way across to the off side for the wide yorker and such was the line that he ended up swinging it straight down to long-on where SKY completes a sharp catch right at the boundary with the ball held over his head and feet just inside the rope
full and wide outside off, and Pooran decides to go on the off side finally, lofts it nicely over the covers and beats long-off easily

he hasn't connected it again but he's found the gap on the leg side and get four. It was a slow cutter just outside off and Pooran swung to leg with so much power that it beat two fielders on either side of deep square leg
gets another wide delivery right without pace, Pooran swings on leg but doesn't middle it and finds square leg
he starts with a slow and wide yorker way outside off, Pooran can't get much bat on it
similar delivery, similar scythe to point where Rohit dives to his right to save a few and listen to that roar from the crowd! He has a shy at the stumps but misses
errs by a small margin while trying another wide yorker and Rahul has scythed that away along the ground to beat backward point and deep third for four. Excellent placement
gets the wide yorker right this time, Rahul can't connect
second wide of the over as Shepherd pitches it well wide outside off, left alone for a wide
slow and juicy full toss around off Rahul has slapped that away with some power into the leg side, just beating the diving fielder for four
excellent yorker angling into the base of off stump, Pooran gets just some bat for one on off
stays still this time for the wide delivery outside the tram line, given a wide
wide yorker outside off, Pooran goes close to the ball to swat it to leg and misses, inside the line too
fourth six of the over and the first of those for Rahul! He charges down to take it on the full and bashes it over the cow corner for a massive blow
nicely bowled, in the block hole outside off, and he slices it square for one off the edge
nearly a fourth six! A lot of muscle into that as Pooran needs to pack some power into that to send it flying over the covers, one-bounce four
you can't bowl there to him, you can't bowl anywhere to him! Walks a long way across to leg, Dhir pitches it around leg and Pooran has slog swept that into the orbit for the third in a row!
another full toss, another six, and that's Pooran's fifty off just 19 balls! On the pads again, short boundaries and he's sent that sailing over the square leg boundary
that's out of here, it's reached Fashion Street! Gets the yorker wrong and it's a juicy full toss on the pads, swiped away over long leg for six
the only dot of the over is Rahul going after a length delivery outside off and missing
slow and low full toss outside off, driven gently through the covers for one

on the stumps and Pooran has belted that on the leg side for his fifth six! MI were trying to avoid this by bowling wide outside off to him which went for sixes too, and the moment Hardik bowls towards the stumps, he he's lofted that to leg for six!
cutting into Rahul from outside off, he cuts the cutter to deep point for one
low full toss outside off and Pooran heaves it down to long-on. Single
Hardik also goes way outside off to Pooran and he has carved that long and far way over the boundary on the off side for a six into the stands !
136.9kmh, nearly another wide yorker and he drives along the ground for one to deep cover
not as clean, the shot, but this one's a full toss and Pooran has sliced that just over Brevis at deep point's heads for six more!
it's getting predictable now. He's going to bowl wide outside off to Pooran, and the batter slams it over the covers for a clean six
goes for the wide yorker again to not give him anything on the leg side, and Pooran connects well this time to slice it away and send it flying to the deep-third boundary for a one-bounce four
too wide outside off, full as well, and it's a wide
gets the wide yorker right and Pooran finds cover
lucky Nicholas Pooran! He opens his stance so wide after going across to off, almost like Chanderpaul, and he swings to leg but only gets an edge fine on the leg side

the first four for KL Rahul comes in the 12th over. He's a little lucky because it's a full toss, probably an attempted yorker, and he walked across early to eventually flick it fine to just beat short fine leg
130.4kmh, mistimes the heave on the leg side and only gets a single off the toe to long off
on the stumps and it's pushed down to long-on for one
133.9kmh, some pace, driven through the covers and another boundary is saved as Shepherd dives to his right and saves two more. Long sprints so far for him
looked like a cutter that was much shorter outside off, Rahul cuts that one at 123kmh to deep point,. Two more
starts wot a slower one full outside off, and Rahul drives it away to sweeper cover where a dive saves two
136.3kmh, back of length on middle and it's a single down to long-on
in the block hole again outside off and it's sliced behind square this time for one to deep third
134.4kmh, full and wide and it's sliced straight to point along the ground
smoked out of here! Short ball to end the streak of wides, and Pooran has absolutely hammered that pull with a lot of muscle almost crashing into Tendulkar's statue
third wide in a row, also full and wide well outside off
a wide full toss way outside off now, another wide
121.5kmh, too short, too wide outside off with the angle and called a wide
some intent from Rahul who backs away and wants to swing, only gets a single to long-on for one
starts with a length ball and it's pushed back
87.9kmh, slower around middle, Pooran defends to mid-off with a straight bat
flatter and quicker on off, he punches it back and it hits the stumps on the other side
swings big on his first ball with the turn and gets a thick edge to midwicket

stunning catch at backward point from Nehal Wadhera! He has hurt himself though. Hooda sliced it on the off side and Wadhera timed his leap perfectly while jumping backwards, got both hands to it but landed badly on his lower back and hit his head on the ground too
84kmh, chips the loopy legbreak over Chawla for a single to long-off
83.6kmh, some turn around off and he cuts it square to point
hint of room and a touch shorter, cut away for the sixth single in a row
84.2kmh, touch fuller and driven down to long-off for one more. Five in a row
some width now and Rahul reaches out for it for a single to sweeper cover
punched to cover and they hare across for a single. Rather, slowed down a bit by the time the throw came in from cover. He's made it, confirms the replay
86.5kmh, full again, drilled down to long-on for one
a big, booming drive through the covers for one off a full delivery
slightly fuller and it's worked down to long-on for one more
looked like a googly, tries to drive to off and he gets a single to leg off an inside edge
width outside off an he frees his arms for a single to sweeper cover
quick and tight on middle, 92.9kmh, defends to cover with soft hands for one
89.6kmh, quicker around off and it's nudged to leg for one more
lovely drift towards middle and then some turn, pushed to sweeper cover for one
Hooda makes up for it. Generously flighted way outside off, too full as well, and Hooda smashes it through the covers for four
one of the poorest long-hops you'll see and Rahul doesn't smash it away! Single to the leg side
shorter toward middle and it's worked down to long-on for one
this time he finds the gap through the covers for one
full outside off again, he drives it away from the body to cover point
83.2km, tossed up outside off, Rahul can't middle it away through covers. The edge goes to leg

the wrong'un works against Stoinis and he's struck right in front! Delivered from just wide of the crease, strikes him dead in front of middle after pitching outside off and he's missed the sweep completely. Plumb and given. Only one review left so he barely even thinks about it
83.4kmh, slows down the wrong'un and drops the length shorter too, Rahul comes down and works it to leg for one
too full now and Rahul makes it a more conformable full toss by coming down and smashes that straight over Chawla's head for another six!
here comes the first six of the match! Not surprisingly, Rahul goes for the leg side boundary behind square and he goes across early to execute a wonderful slog sweep for the fullish delivery
drift towards the base of leg stump, pretty full, and Rahul drives it inside out to mid off
tossed up around leg and he nudges it to midwicket for one

direct hit at the non-striker's end and it's gone upstairs, although looked safe to me. Stoinis took off after pushing it down to mid-off and he slid is bat just in time to make it safely. No damage there for LSG
128.9kmh, takes some pace off with the angle outside off, Rahul gets a thick inside edge to leg for one
back of length outside off and he punches patiently to cover
chips it back just wide of Arjun's right hand, almost giving a catch, and it's a single down to long-on
overcompensates his line after that width and delivers a wide down leg. Hang on, Mumbai have reviewed that. The spike on UltraEdge pops up when the ball is next to the pad. Nicely done by MI
excellent placement for four! Just a hint of width outside off, no inswing this time and he opens the face of the bat late enough to thread the gap between backward point and short third for four
136.4kmh, lofts that one again down the ground and it reaches long-on after a bounce
more muscle than timing this time. Not a very bad ball on length around off and he swung it down over mid-on for a powerful third four in a row
way too full to Stoinis and he's lofted it straight down over the umpire for another four
swings across the line as Kamboj drops it shorter and the fielder at midwicket almost dives over that and it races away for four
cramped for room on off and Stoinis straight-bats it down to mid-off
short of length towards Rahul who works it down towards mid-on for one
116.7kmh, slower one to end the over and Rahul pushes to mid-on with soft hands for another quick one
punches the ball down from middle stump to mid-on. Another quick single
on middle and leg, and Stoinis clips it square to square leg in the circle
137.7kmh, swinging away from length, but it's too wide and out of his reach. Just inside the tram line though
118.7kmh, the slower one is too full and Stoinis has picked that to loft it easily over the bowler's head for the first four of the night
a near-worker on leg stump which Rahul bunts down to mid-on for a quick single
134.6kmh, bit more pace to end the over as Arjun swings it in again towards middle and leg. No room at all and Stoinis dead-bats it
some swing to almost end the over, it's a wide past the pads down leg
goes short after four dot balls and Stoinis gets two to deep midwicket with a pull
big, flashing cover drive but it ends only in a thick inside edge onto his pad. It was the inswing again

massive, massive never-ending appeal from Arjun and the finger finally goes up! Stoinis uses the only review LSG have in the bank. The only question is height for me. It was the inswing that beat Stoinis on the back foot as he went on his toes, hitting the top of the pad flap in front of middle and leg. Ball-tracking says it's going over! So Stoinis and the only LSG review survive
130.6kmh, inswing again, this time from off towards middle and he punches to cover this time
swings it nicely into Stoinis from middle to leg and the batter defends it back
135.2kmh, the straight bat again and Rahul drives it gently to cover this time
133.6kmh, on target once again on middle stump. Rahul defends with a straight bat
right on target on middle stump at 132kmh, Stoinis is a tad late and gets an inside edge to fine leg for one
even further down leg, Stoinis doesn't even bother and Kishan has to dive full length to get his hands on it
errs well down the leg side for a big wide

out first ball Devdutt Padikkal! Thushara swings it dangerously into the batter and he's beaten completely. That struck him right in front of middle stump, low as well, but let's see if it's swinging too much because he reviewed the on-field decision after the umpire raised the finger. No edge, so we wait for ball-tracking. Pitching on middle, hitting in line, crashing into leg, review gone for LSG in three balls
strays on the pads a little after he delivers from close to the umpire and Rahul tucks it away to fine leg. Off the mark
starts nearly in the block hole around off with some lovely outswing and Rahul digs it out
full, wide, six. Terrific finish from Dhir, terrific innings, superb maiden half-century in this format. Lovely, clean hit over extra-cover to bring Mumbai's season, and LSG's season, to an end
in the blockhole wide outside off, stretches out to try and lap-sweep, can't get bat to it, only his boot. Shepherd looks for the leg bye but Dhir sends him back
length ball outside off, punched to deep point, brings Dhir back on strike, and why not. This crowd wants to watch him bat
short, angling down leg, can't connect with the hook
gone, Kishan's scratchy innings comes to an end. Slants a fullish ball well outside off, away from his hitting arc. Slogs, and only manages an inside-edge into his stumps

six more, or it very nearly was! Krunal Pandya keeps it in, and shuts out Mumbai's hopes, barring extras. Full, in the slot outside off, and Dhir launches it towards long-off, clean and fairly flat. Krunal, falling backwards over the boundary, reaches over his head and palms the ball back into the field of play. They only run one, so Dhir is off strike too

there's the fifty. Another lovely hit. This is short outside off, and it gets up to chest height, and he's on the front foot to play another of those baseball hits. Smacks it so cleanly, up and over wide long-on
full now, slanting away from off stump, drilled firmly to long-off to keep the strike
another full-toss, but Kishan can't get hold of it. Loses his shape while trying to hit over long-on, and ends up slicing it. On the bounce, down to the fielder
low full-toss close to off stump, whipped firmly to long-on

wow, another outstanding hit. This is shortish, angling away from off stump, and he hits this like a baseballer, weight on his front foot, and a free swing across the ball to launch it over wide long-on
full, slanting away from off stump, and that's beautifully timed! Lovely hands from Dhir to slice underneath the ball and carve it up and over the backward point region. Carries all the way too
slower ball wide of off stump, left alone, and called wide. Rolls down to the keeper, who fumbles and allows another run
in the blockhole outside off, squeezed out to extra-cover, to the right of the fielder
slower ball, fullish, slanting away from off stump and keeping a bit low. Sneaks under the attempted leg-side slog

Kishan hasn't had a lot of strike of late, but he finds the boundary here. Steps across to the full-toss angled away from him, and gets down on his back knee to sweep it away to the square leg boundary
shortish slower ball wide of off stump, swiped into the vacant short midwicket region, forcing the bowler to do some fielding
hip-high hard-length ball angling into the batter, and he steps across and whips it to the right of deep backward square leg. Always wanted two, and convinces a reluctant Kishan to run the second too

and Dhir hits it alright. Difficult ball to hit, short, gets up high fairly wide of off stump, but he gets both feet off the ground and hits a tennis-style down-the-line forehand past the bowler, and beats long-on throwing himself to his left

offcutter, shortish, gets up around Dhir's stomach, cramping him on the pull. He's forced to hit from down to up, and he doesn't get much pace onto the bat, and ends up picking out deep square leg, the substitute Prerak Mankad. But just when LSG begin to celebrate, the no-ball klaxxon begins to sound
short slower ball outside off, sits up nicely, and Dhir pulls powerfully to the left of deep midwicket, where Padikkal puts in a sprint and a dive to keep it from reaching the boundary
full outside off, driven to sweeper cover

bam! Krunal finally floats one into a batter's hitting arc. Actually not the worst ball because it gripped a bit and straightened from an off-stumpish line and from a good length rather than a half-volley length, but Dhir hit that so well, and so cleanly over wide long-on
full-toss, and put away, but was that where he was looking to put it away? Maybe? Wide outside off, fairly high, and he stretches across and slices it away to the left of short third
yorker length on off stump, clipped down to long-on
full outside off, driven to long-off
goes wide of off stump, too wide, and Dhir leaves it alone

KL misses a possible stumping, but a tough one. Looks to flick a length ball that straightens along a middle-stump line, and the ball hits bat, pad, and rolls to the right of KL even as Dhir stumbles out of his crease. Looks to kick the ball onto the stumps but misses the target
shortish offcutter, gets up to waist height, finishing just outside off. Pulled to deep midwicket
looks for the wide yorker, ends up a touch too wide. Left alone
short outside off, another slower ball dug into the pitch. Steps across, shapes for the uppercut, but is defeated by extra bounce and lack of pace
full, slanting away from off stump, driven along the ground to long-on
short, slower offcutter dug into the pitch, follows the batter's move to the leg side. Pulled to the left of deep backward square leg
shortish, at the hip, pulled away to the left of deep midwicket

that brings the required rate down, slightly. Shortish, and Dhir had premeditatedly walked across his stumps, shaping for the scoop over fine leg. Not the length he was hoping for, but he goes through with the shot and it goes over the keeper and it nearly goes all the way
wrong'un again, and it keeps low too, leaving Dhir vulnerable to lbw as he walks across his stumps. Manages to connect with the flick, hits it uppishly but on the bounce to deep midwicket
legbreak, ends up short and offering width. Cut away into the gap between backward point and short third
another wrong'un, and this time he's hanging back, shaping to cut, maybe. Ends up cramped completely for room, jabs it back towards the bowler
quickish wrong'un, good length outside off, stretches out and defends back to the bowler

five down. The Bishnoi wrong'un gets another left-hander. Angles it wide of Wadhera's hitting arc, and the attempted slog-sweep ends up miscued, hit straighter and higher and with less power than intended, straight to the man at long-on
shortish, angling away into a wide line outside off, stops on the pitch too. Attempted cut ends up as a straight pull back towards the bowler
wide of the crease, bowls a length ball angling in towards off stump. Good stride forward to punch to mid-off
full and wide, not quite a wide yorker in terms of length. Looks to reach out and drive, gets a thick inside edge that rolls past his off stump
slower bouncer outside off, left alone and called wide. Loopy bounce, definitely went above head height
oooh, and Mohsin nearly spears a yorker through him first up! Doesn't miss off stump by much after Wadhera jams his bat down and misses

gone, Hardik has uppercut this straight down deep third's throat! Short ball from Mohsin, and he controls the angle across the right-hander well so Hardik doesn't get room to free his arms. This uppercut ends up being mostly wrists, and he can't generate enough power to clear the man in the deep
short slower ball outside leg, swivels to hook but can't connect. Stepped across slightly, and didn't finish that far down leg, so not called wide
full-toss close to off stump, gets on the front foot to carve to deep backward point
shortish, angling across and away from off stump, slapped to deep point
length ball, keeps going with the angle into leg stump, punched with a straight bat to deep midwicket
another wide half-volley, and the Wankhede (or most of it) can't help but cheer as Hardik frees his arms and dumps this beyond the extra-cover boundary. Lovely, clean strike
quickish length ball, keeps going with the angle into the pads, clipped to the right of long-on
wide half-volley, and Pandya puts it away, thrashes a drive to the right of extra-cover, who doesn't, and can't, move
wide length ball turning away. Throws his hands at it, carves it to short third
quicker now, on middle and leg, watchfully clipped down to long-on

slower this time, and the length ball grips and straightens from outside leg stump. Closes his bat face looking for the single to the leg side, and the leading edge hangs in the air briefly but falls well short of the bowler
length ball slanting into middle and leg, defended into the covers
fired across full, pitching on middle stump close to his feet. Clears the front leg and swipes, and the inside edge rolls down towards deep backward square leg
shortish, wide of off, sticks in the pitch a little, slapped to long-off
back of  a length, angling in towards off stump, punched to extra-cover
quickish, angling into off stump, keeps going with the angle. Steps back and punches to deep point

got him, Bishnoi has a massive wicket after taking that massive catch. Full outside off, wide of off in fact, and Rohit has to reach for it. Was looking to drive wristily through the covers, and the ball gripped a bit and turned to take his outside edge, nice easy catch for short third. Everyone at the Wankhede is up on their feet as Rohit walks off, and a few boos ring out too, no doubt greeting the man replacing him at the crease

not the best timing, but he puts it in the gap. A touch short and a touch wide outside off for the slog-sweep, and he's hitting against the turn, but he manages to hit it into the gap between deep midwicket and long-on
quick legbreak wide of off, good length. Rohit tries to reverse-sweep and misses
another wrong'un, slower and fuller, on the stumps. Looks to work it leg side, probably didn't pick it, and sends a leading edge down to long-off. Was briefly in the air but not near any LSG player
wrong'un going across, back of a length, goes back and chops into the covers
flat length ball on middle and off, a hint of turn away, defended back to the bowler
length ball angling into the stumps, no real turn, goes back and works it to the right of deep midwicket
floats this across to finish outside off, slog-swiped down to long-on
length ball slanting across to off stump, straightens a touch, goes back and clips to midwicket

Bishnoi! What a moment! He'd fumbled one in the outfield a few overs ago, and now Suryakumar absolutely hammers a sweep in his direction, on the full, and the ball hits his palms and pops out for one horrifying instant, before he catches it on the second attempt. What a way to go. Absolutely nailed the sweep off a Krunal ball angling down leg, and he hit it so hard and flat, a couple of steps to the right of the man at deep backward square leg
quick, angling down leg, misses the sweep and KL can't collect cleanly either. Given as runs, not wides or leg byes
slower short ball outside off, and it begins to die even before it reaches the batter, sneaking below his attempted pull which he's already almost through
back of a length, angling into the corridor, lets it come and dabs to backward point

gone, that's LSG's first wicket. Naveen gets it with a full-toss. Angling in towards off stump, and Brevis tries to hit over mid-on but loses control of his hands and ends up slicing the ball in an unintended direction, up in the air for long-off to catch after a sprint to his left

shot. Naveen lands one in his arc, outside off but coming in with that angle from wide of the crease, and he's quickly down almost onto his back knee to launch it cleanly over cow corner with a free, full swing of his bat
shortish, angling into the corridor from wide of the crease. Skids through a bit low, and sneaks under the attempted pull
Brevis finally gets one away. Attempted wide yorker, and he throws his bat at it and carves it away to the right of backward point. Short third is also in the circle, so no one is cutting it off
good finish to the over. That skid he gets with a bit of low bounce. The line was there for the cut, but it hurries through and beats his inside edge
clever. Uses the Bishnoi angle so well, and the pace too. Angling down leg, overcompensation for the previous ball, and he stretches across and plays the lap-sweep over short fine leg
bad ball, looped up wide of off, and Rohit takes full toll, smacking a flat-bat drive to the right of extra-cover
looks to make room now, and is cramped by Bishnoi's angle into the stumps. Nice length, on the shorter side ofr good, amnd he chops it into the covers
not quite as short, another wrong'un - or maybe it's just the angle he creates - and Brevis is deep in his crease to pull to the right of deep midwicket
short wrong'un, skids through quickly, and a touch low, to beat Brevis on the pull and strike him on the thigh pad. Missing leg by a ling way
back of a length, finishing on middle and off to cramp Rohit. Hops to get on top of the bounce and block it back where it came from

down the track now, and that's a Rohit special to bring up the half-century. Charges the bowler, gets close to the length of the ball but not too close to the line, so he can free his arms and launch it with a free, unfettered swing, straight back over the bowler's head. The crowd at the Wankhede is loving this
back of a length outside off, was looking to chop it down to deep third, ends up inside-edging it firmly into the pitch
shortish outside off, extra bounce to beat the cut

shot. Much better timing. Back of a length, a little bit of width, and Rohit meets the cut right on top of the bounce and beats backward point diving to his left. Not too far to his left, but it was travelling too quickly to stop

length ball angling across, finishing just outside off. Rohit is looking to loft over mid-off or extra-cover, end he ends up slicing it square, and it lands and rolls away towards deep third, where Bishnoi messes up a straightforward stop
full, fairly wide of off, bit of loop on this slower ball. Driven along the ground, without too much power, to point
length ball, angling in to finish on top of off stump. Stays leg-side of the ball and pushes towards mid-off, who's on the edge of the circle, allowing the quick single

shot. Not the best ball Naveen has bowled, in the slot, angling in towards off stump, and Rohit doesn't quite time the ball - it was delivered cross-seam, and may have stuck on the pitch - but he clears mid-off easily with the high-elbow checked loft

dug in short outside off, loses a lot of pace off the pitch but bounces steeply. Rohit, making room, has to get on his toes to reach it and uppercut. Ends up putting it away beyond short third on the 30-yard circle and it runs away for four
wide of the crease, angles this length ball into the stumps, clipped away to the right of mid-on
full, angling into leg stump. Looks for the flick into the leg side, closes his bat face early, and sends a leading edge rolling down to long-on
back of a length, slanting across, chopped away to the left of point
length ball slanting away into a wide-ish line, and Rohit slogs across it, aiming leg side, loses his shape, and misses
length ball on off stump, lets it come and looks for the pushed single into the extra-cover region, but it's too close to the bowler's follow-through in the end

beauty. Length ball pitching within the line of the stumps, then nipping away off the deck to accentuate the away angle, and beat the outside edge while opening Rohit up in defence. Looked like the slower cutter
four more, though not in the intended direction. Full-toss, slanting away from off stump. Throws his bat at it and the ball runs away off the outside edge, between the keeper and short third
shortish, wide, and Rohit reaches out and slaps it away between point and cover point
full, angling into middle and leg, blocked back to the bowler

sees Brevis looking to make room and spears the full, wide ball outside off. As close to a wide yorker as you'll get from a spinner. Left alone, and I think it finished just inside the tramline. MI review, and the umpire's no-wide decision is upheld

shot! Looks to bowl quick and into the pitch and cramp Brevis with his inward angle, but ends up bowling a touch too short. Onto the length in a flash to pull it a long way beyond the midwicket boundary
flat length ball angling into the stumps, no turn away. Hangs back and works it to deep midwicket
flat, length, speared into the pads, worked away to deep midwicket
quickish, back of a length, angling in towards off stump. Makes room and chops to cover point
length ball, tighter line, finishing on off and middle, defended with soft hands and the ball rolls towards deep square leg for one
not quite short enough for the cut, and the ball may have stopped on Brevis too. Thick inside edge into the pitch, and it bounces towards the keeper, having passed not too far from off stump
bnow he goes short, digs in the bouncer slanted across the batter, and it bounces well over head height and is left alone
once again, trusts in that angle away from off stump, keeping it just short of a length. Punched firmly into the covers
back of a length, slanting away from off, this time Rohit's chop goes a bit finer, further to the left of point, and they sneak a quick single
slower ball, back of a length, angling away from off stump, chopped to point
length ball, slanting away from off stump. Flat-bats it, without timing it, towards short extra-cover
good ball! Length, in the corridor, and it straightens off the pitch to beat the edge of a leaden-footed Brevis. Just stood there and looked to punch through mid-off/extra-cover

sees Rohit shaping for the lap-sweep, I think, and bowls a slower offcutter outside off. Not much pace to work with, and he picks up a single down to fine leg. Wanted to play it much finer, but didn't get the pace he wanted
wow, sensational shot. Makes a lot of room, exposes all his stumps, and frees his arms to hit this off-stump length ball over the long-off boundary
bam. Just a touch short, it's barely finishing above bail height, angling in towards middle stump, and he opens up at the hips and pulls disdainfully over the forward square leg boundary
length ball close to off stump, punched towards short extra-cover
shortish, angling down leg, too far down leg for Rohit to connect with the pull
back of a length, finishing over the top of off stump, gets on top of the bounce and uses his wrists to play it down into the pitch
ooh, good ball. Straightens from a good length, towards off stump, and there's some extra bounce too. Hops to get on top of the bounce and dab into the covers
length ball slanting across into the corridor, left alone
length ball, swinging into the pads, tucked down to fine leg
nice. Fullish length, swinging in towards leg stump, shows the full face and punches to mid-on
inswing again, but starts down the leg side and finishes a long way down the leg side. Rahul dives but can't reach the ball, which rolls down to fine leg

ooh, plays for inswing now but the ball keeps going with the angle across him. Feet don't move either, and he gets squared up while trying to work the ball into the leg side. Leading edge pops off the shoulder of the bat, to the right of the diving backward point fielder
a bit of inswing heading down the leg side, and a bit of bounce. Cramps Rohit, who misses his hopping flick and is hit on the thigh pad
